name: Admin Toolkit — Customers
description: All-hands overview: observed reach, repeat use, and useful workflows. Internal = tam-global/akaos serving installations; all others = customers. Only observed installations with analytics enabled, working network access, and an instrumented version are represented. Read each insight description for its denominator and limits. Current calendar periods are incomplete.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Active installations — 30 days
insights.description: Distinct installations with a webapp open or module visit in the last 30 days, compared with the preceding 30 days. This is observed reach, not customer companies or the installed base. Opt-outs, offline and older installations are absent.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Active users — 30 days
insights.description: Distinct pseudonymous users in the whole 30-day window, compared with the preceding 30 days. Do not sum weekly unique users. Identity is scoped to each installation; browser fallback can count one person more than once.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Monthly active installations
insights.description: Distinct active installations in each calendar month. The current month is incomplete; first observed activity is not an installation date.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Active users
insights.description: Distinct users per calendar week opening the app or navigating modules. Automatic scans do not count. Current week is incomplete.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Module adoption
insights.description: Distinct visitors per module over the whole last 30 days. Users can appear in several modules; do not sum rows as total users.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Month retention
insights.description: First-ever observed activity cohorts returning to open or navigate the app in a later calendar period. Use cohort counts alongside percentages; exclude incomplete periods. Collection starts at rollout, not original installation. This is user retention, not customer/company retention.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Exports and comparisons
insights.description: Diagnostic bundles built and handed to the browser, and successfully computed comparisons. Download events do not prove files were saved. These are optional workflows, not prerequisites for meaningful use.

name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Adoption
description: Product review: which modules earn use, where visits reach results, and whether users return. Internal = tam-global/akaos serving installations; all others = customers. Only observed installations with analytics enabled, working network access, and an instrumented version are represented. Read each insight description for its denominator and limits. Current calendar periods are incomplete.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Module adoption
insights.description: Distinct visitors per module over the whole last 30 days. Users can appear in several modules; do not sum rows as total users.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Plugin versions
insights.description: Distinct active installations by observed plugin version in the last 30 days. An installation that upgrades appears under both versions; this is observed version usage, not an inventory of the latest installed version.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Module opened → results viewed
insights.description: Per visit, including ready-on-open pages. Results means at least one completed data source was displayed, not proof of reading. Settings, help, and other modules without scan results are not expected to convert; inspect data-bearing modules individually.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Week retention
insights.description: First-ever observed activity cohorts returning to open or navigate the app in a later calendar period. Use cohort counts alongside percentages; exclude incomplete periods. Collection starts at rollout, not original installation. This is user retention, not customer/company retention.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Month retention
insights.description: First-ever observed activity cohorts returning to open or navigate the app in a later calendar period. Use cohort counts alongside percentages; exclude incomplete periods. Collection starts at rollout, not original installation. This is user retention, not customer/company retention.

name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Reliability
description: Engineering review: scan outcomes, observed completion, latency, and release investigation. Internal = tam-global/akaos serving installations; all others = customers. Only observed installations with analytics enabled, working network access, and an instrumented version are represented. Read each insight description for its denominator and limits. Current calendar periods are incomplete.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Scan outcomes
insights.description: Recorded lifecycle starts, completions, failures, and cancellations. These are event volumes, not a completion percentage: events can cross date boundaries. Use Observed scan completion for a matched-start denominator.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Observed scan completion
insights.description: Observed starts reaching completion within one hour, matched by scan_id. Excludes starts inferred after completion. Breakdown separates automatic/manual/on-demand work. Failed/cancelled scans, tab closes, host switches, missing events, and longer scans can all leave a gap.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Scan started → completed → results viewed
insights.description: Observed starts, completion, then visible results for the same scan_id within one hour. Includes background scans; viewing every background result is not expected. Filter trigger to focus on deliberate tasks.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Slow scans (p95)
insights.description: 95th-percentile duration of successful runs, in milliseconds, by scan source over the last 30 days. Failed or stalled scans are absent. Read alongside sample counts; small samples are unstable. A scan source can serve several modules.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Completed scan samples
insights.description: Successful run counts per scan source for the same 30-day window as the p95 table. Use these counts before prioritizing slow sources.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Failures by plugin version
insights.description: Recorded scan failure counts by version. This is volume, not a failure rate: popular versions naturally have more opportunities to fail. Filter the completion funnel to the same version before calling a release a regression.

insights.name: Admin Toolkit — Customers — Scan trigger mix
insights.description: Starts by automatic/manual/on_demand/unknown trigger. On-demand means a page requested data, not necessarily a button click. Use this to interpret background work before judging scan funnel drop-off.
